name: states-01
description: Grey placeholders shaped like a row of stats, shown while data loads so nothing shifts when it arrives.

files.content:
'use client' import { BlockStateProvider, type BlockStatus, type LoadStatus, useBlockData, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/block-state' import { Stat, StatChange, StatGroup, StatLabel, type StatMetric, StatValue, formatStatValue, getStatPlaceholders, } from '@/registry/components/dashboardblocks/stat-group' import { IconPlaceholder } from '@/registry/icons/icon-placeholder' import { formatCurrency, formatPercent } from '@/registry/lib/dashboardblocks/format' import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button' interface States1Props { /** Follows the change, such as `the previous 30 days`. */ comparison: string description: string load: () => Promise placeholders?: number title: string } const exampleProps: States1Props = { comparison: 'the previous 30 days', description: 'The last 30 days, compared with the 30 days before.', load: () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout( () => resolve([ { formatter: (value) => formatCurrency(value), key: 'revenue', label: 'Revenue', previous: 42_890, value: 48_210, }, { key: 'orders', label: 'Orders', previous: 1_210, value: 1_284 }, { changeType: 'points', formatter: (value) => formatPercent(value / 100), goodDirection: 'down', key: 'refunds', label: 'Refund rate', previous: 2.1, value: 1.8, }, ]), 1_500, ), ), placeholders: 3, title: 'Overview', } function toBlockStatus(status: LoadStatus): BlockStatus | undefined { if (status === 'idle' || status === 'loading') return 'loading' if (status === 'error') return 'error' return undefined } const States1 = (props: States1Props) => { const { comparison, description, load, placeholders = 3, title } = props const { data = [], reload, status: loadStatus } = useBlockData(load) const status = toBlockStatus(loadStatus) const loading = status === 'loading' const shown = loading ? getStatPlaceholders(placeholders) : data return (

{title}

{description}

{shown.map((metric) => ( {metric.label} {formatStatValue(metric)} ))}
) } export { States1, exampleProps as states1ExampleProps, type States1Props }
